name: MiniMax H3 Lite
description: A lightweight multimodal video generation model supporting text-to-video, first and last frame image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation at 480P and 768P.

examples.name: Vertical Latte Art
examples.description: A cheap 480P vertical clip for social feeds.

content.text: Top-down shot of latte art being poured into a ceramic cup on a wooden café table, the milk forms a rosetta pattern in slow motion. Cozy morning light, vertical framing for social.

examples.name: Mascot Comes to Life 480P
examples.description: The same first and last frames as the H3 Highspeed example, at Lite's cheaper 480P.

content.text: A flat illustrated robot mascot printed on a notebook page wakes up, blinks, peels itself off the paper into a glossy 3D toy, hops onto the wooden desk next to the coffee mug and waves at the camera. Warm morning light, playful stop-motion feel, one continuous shot.
